How are these different?

These are two separate statuses, so either can apply without the other.

QP status comes from meeting the Advanced APM payment or patient thresholds. It sets the conversion factor: $32.9548 per RVU in 2027, vs $32.6286 for non-QPs.

B2 is for clinicians in a Medicare Shared Savings Program or LEAD ACO, whether or not they are QPs. Everyone else billing for complexity uses B1.

  • Neither: non-QP rate + B1
  • ACO only: non-QP rate + B2. Common in lower-risk MSSP tracks, which aren’t Advanced APMs.
  • Both: QP rate + B2
  • QP only: QP rate + B1, e.g. through a non-ACO Advanced APM
